events.title: Remembering Woodstock Festival
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Festival took place in 1969, featuring legendary performances from Jimi Hendrix and The Who.

angles.name: Woodstock Anniversary
angles.copy: 57 years ago the music world changed forever at Woodstock, we're looking back at the performances that made history.

events.title: Elvis Presley: Remembering The King
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of Elvis Presley's death in 1977, the legendary musician who left a lasting impact on the music world.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: The King of Rock and Roll may be gone, but his music lives on, we're celebrating Elvis' life and legacy.

events.title: Tupac Shakur: A Lasting Legacy
events.blurb: Tupac Shakur was shot dead in Las Vegas in 1996, leaving behind a legacy that continues to inspire and influence music today.

angles.name: Tupac Shakur Tribute
angles.copy: 25 years on from his tragic death, we're remembering the life and music of Tupac Shakur, a true hip-hop legend.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix: A Legendary Guitarist
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of Jimi Hendrix's death in 1970, a legendary guitarist who left an indelible mark on the music world.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: We're celebrating the life and music of Jimi Hendrix, a true rock legend who continues to inspire generations of musicians.

events.title: The Beatles Release Abbey Road
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album Abbey Road in 1969, featuring some of the band's most beloved songs.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: 57 years ago The Beatles released Abbey Road, an album that would go on to become one of the most influential in music history.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde Turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' lead singer Chrissie Hynde turns 75 today, with a career spanning over four decades.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: The unmistakable voice of The Pretenders, Chrissie Hynde, turns 75 today, we're celebrating her incredible career and music.

events.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 55
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher turns 55 today, with a career marked by iconic songs and a distinctive voice.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: The voice of Oasis, Liam Gallagher, turns 55 today, we're looking back at his incredible career and the music that defined a generation.

events.title: John Lennon Releases Imagine
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic album Imagine in 1971, featuring the title track that has become an anthem for peace and unity.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: John Lennon's powerful album Imagine was released 55 years ago, we're celebrating the music and message that continues to inspire today.

events.title: Apple Releases The First iPod
events.blurb: Apple released the first iPod in 2001, revolutionizing the way people listen to music on the go.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: 25 years ago Apple changed the music landscape with the release of the first iPod, we're looking back at how it impacted the way we listen to music.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the iconic spy created by Ian Fleming, with a legacy that spans over six decades.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Shaken not stirred, we're celebrating James Bond Day with a look back at the iconic films and characters that have captivated audiences worldwide.

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, one of the most influential musicians of all time, would have been 86 today, with a legacy that continues to inspire and influence music.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: We're celebrating the life and music of John Lennon, a true legend who would have been 86 today, with a legacy that continues to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: Comedy legend John Cleese turns 87 today, with a career spanning over six decades and countless iconic roles.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: The legendary John Cleese turns 87 today, we're looking back at his incredible career and the comedy classics that have made us laugh for generations.

events.title: The Beatles Release The White Album
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic self-titled album, commonly known as The White Album, in 1968, featuring a diverse range of songs and styles.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 54 years ago The Beatles released The White Album, a groundbreaking album that pushed the boundaries of music and art.

events.title: Freddie Mercury: A Lasting Legacy
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death in 1991, the iconic Queen frontman who left an indelible mark on the music world.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: We're remembering the incredible life and music of Freddie Mercury, a true rock legend who continues to inspire and entertain audiences around the world.
